findings.title: Back to gate 1 from RESCOPE_REQUIRED cannot complete and retries forever
findings.detail: stage_for sends RESCOPE_REQUIRED with pending feedback (Make it smaller / Split, allowed by ProposalService.request_revision) to scout.run. By then the task volume holds the build clone and sandboxd refuses to destroy it (not terminal, not PRE_START_STATES). The scout-mode fetch job clones into /work/repo; fetch.sh removes it only when .scout-clone exists, so git clone hits a non-empty directory and fails clone_failed. Scheduler.fail is a no-op because RESCOPE_REQUIRED is in NO_FAIL, and the next tick (10 s) re-dispatches: unbounded clone jobs, failed stage runs and audit rows, no owner message. After a re-approval the real fetch would hit the same non-empty volume. No runner or e2e test covers RESCOPE_REQUIRED (likely: code paths confirmed, not run). Fix: re-scout from the existing build tree (ro snapshot) or clone into a separate path; reset or reuse the volume for the post-re-approval fetch; alert and back off on repeated StageFailed in NO_FAIL states; add tests for Smaller/Split from RESCOPE_REQUIRED.

findings.title: The scheduler only sees the newest 200 contributions of any state
findings.detail: Scheduler._dispatch iterates gk.contributions(limit=200); ContributionService.list orders by updated_at DESC over every state (route le=200). Discovery keeps adding mostly-SKIPPED candidates, so after enough cycles quiet WATCHING items (open PRs whose review comments need answers), snoozed and expired proposals fall out of the window and are never dispatched. Fix: list only states with a stage (state-set or active filter in the gatekeeper) or paginate; test with >200 terminal rows and one old WATCHING item.

findings.title: AC 2: the needs_key sandbox cases still never run
findings.detail: ROOTDEV pytest -m 'sandbox or e2e_docker' gave 11 passed, 2 skipped. tests/sandbox/test_profiles.py test_kiro_host_connect and test_workspace_canary_s_ws_1 are bodiless functions under an unconditional skip, although AC 2 requires them to run against the real key. The ADR-0005 item-30 addendum still says items 5b, 6 and 8 are pending a live probe while TRACEABILITY marks DES-V-8 done. Fix: implement both tests for when the key is present (or assert the recorded live 'workspace' probe result for the current tuple for S-ws-1) and update the ADR-0005 addendum (item 8 result; 5b/6 moved).

findings.title: TRACEABILITY rows closed with evidence that does not prove them; FEAT-006-only rows left open
findings.detail: DES-V-17 (public_repo sufficiency for fork/push/PR/comments, latency, secondary limits) and DES-V-18 (commit email verified on Amsal1, not linked to <work-login>) are done with the generic 'catalog 20 ids, probes 5/5, kiro smoke pong, targets verify 73/73' string, which touches neither; ADR-0006 still lists fork/push/PR as pending. DES-V-8 has the same string. DES-V-5/5a/21/24/33 cite runner code instead of the ADR-0005 addendum. DES-V-9, CR4-1h and CR4-2c name only FEAT-006 and are still missing; DES-V-5b and DES-V-6 say '-> FEAT-007' but their phase column is still P2 FEAT-006; DES-FR-14 still says the import CLI is missing. Fix each row with its real evidence or owner FEAT and recount Totals.

findings.title: Docs offer the test roles in the Telegram /model picker (user decision: never)
findings.detail: The user decided test and test_vision are changed only via config/models.yaml or ossctl model set test ... and never offered in /model. DESIGN §16 'Test roles' paragraph says 'Telegram /model', README 'Models' says 'including test ... or the Telegram /model picker', and TRACEABILITY MDL-3 lists 'Telegram /model picker shows test roles (FEAT-009)' as remaining work. No picker code exists yet. Fix the three texts and make MDL-3 (or a new row) require FEAT-009 to exclude and test the exclusion of test roles.

findings.title: A model switch is audited but not announced on Telegram
findings.detail: ModelsAdmin.set_model appends a model_set audit event and returns the diff; PUT /v1/models/{role} returns it to ossctl; nothing is queued on the outbox. DESIGN §16 and the user require changes (incl. test roles) to be audited, catalog-validated and announced by a Telegram FYI. Fix: queue one owner FYI (role, old -> new, actor, forced) in the audit transaction and add a test in test_models_admin.py.

findings.title: Full safety-probe run (~80 s) exceeds the owner's 60 s target, which is recorded nowhere
findings.detail: The FEAT handoff records ~80 s for six sequential Kiro sessions (doctor --probes 86 s in VERIFICATION) against the owner's 60 s target; inconclusive retries make it longer. No DESIGN section or TRACEABILITY row tracks the target. Fix: run independent probes concurrently or bound each session, or ask the owner (hard rule 12) to accept the measured figure and record it in DESIGN §10.9.

findings.title: Runner case of test_crash_safety.sh passes vacuously
findings.detail: It SIGKILLs ossbot-runner and checks that no stage run is left running with a stale heartbeat, without first putting a stage in running, so an idle runner passes. Seed a running stage against the fake upstream before the kill and assert it is re-queued.

findings.title: targets verify transient unit lacks the runner hardening
findings.detail: ossctl targets verify runs verify_targets via systemd-run --uid=ossrunner with only EnvironmentFile and PrivateTmp. Add NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem=strict, ProtectHome, RestrictAddressFamilies, the io_uring SystemCallFilter/SystemCallErrorNumber, CapabilityBoundingSet= and a firewall --check first.

findings.title: VERIFICATION 'Phase 2 live checks' is stale and self-contradictory
findings.detail: The Root suites and System tests rows still say not run (round 2 ran them: sandbox/e2e_docker 11 passed 2 skipped; the five system suites all passed), and the 'Global switch: not exercised as a live switch' row contradicts 'Global switch, live'. Record the results and drop the contradiction.
